(2) **`arm_watchdog` READY 실패 경로의 detached watchdog 누수** — flag 는 아직 OFF 라 즉시 피해는 없으나 살아남은 watchdog 이 **나중의 정상 영구 ON 을 되돌린다**. flag write 전에만 `os.killpg` 로 제거한다. findings.issue: A malformed policy value passed all three invariants and was approved as premium-only in the final stage. findings.disposition: Policy values are validated where they are read and where the invariant runs, and the planner branches explicitly per enum member with a raising else. A terminating protocol exists — the author prepares the complete fixed/pass candidate first, the opposite participant reviews that exact tree without editing it, and the unchanged tree is committed. The commit operation does not create new file content; any post-review tree edit invalidates the attestation and reopens review. C6 also said review edges record technical work only but omitted the Codex-authored SEM-021 validator and residual corrections that Claude had just reviewed. Cross-review accepted the correction rather than defending the earlier claim: the regress was an artifact of this process, not a property of review. Each round the reviewer kept editing after reviewing, which manufactured new unreviewed content; if the author prepares the complete candidate and the opposite participant reviews that exact tree without touching it, the commit contains only reviewed content and the edge asserting that review is verifiable by the reviewer itself, so nothing is circular. One verification held as written and one did not. Emptying the pass-lifecycle patterns turns the suite red. Replacing the closed fixture with the live journal was red only while that journal was open: in the final pass tree the helper became a no-op and the mutation survived, so the load-bearing claim had been checked in one state and asserted about another. The counterexample base now starts from a synthetic open journal, which makes the helper load-bearing regardless of the live verdict. Reviewing that correction in turn found the scaffold unlocked: turning _synthetic_open_journal into a no-op restores the original defect silently, because the base falls back to the live journal and the closed fixture goes inert again. A regression now asserts that the synthetic open state really produces errors, so all three mutations — the fixture, the pending-language patterns, and the scaffold itself — are red in the final pass tree.
